text:
Evan: post-deploy quickcheck for auth-proxy (us-east). Canary v6.1.0 shows p95 jump to ~900ms and sporadic 502s on /auth/start.

Deploy-bot: Canary completed 6m ago. No automatic rollback.

Evan: tagging @tori @eng-oncall — propose PAUSE further rollout and pin traffic back to v6.0.9 while we triage.

Tori: ack, pulling traces. Failures look concentrated on proxy-21 around 14:05 UTC.

Smokebot: starting targeted synthetic run 3752468012-t1 against proxy-19..23 (20 reqs, concurrency 4) with header x-model: v6.1.0.

Smokebot: job complete — 4/20 requests returned 502, p95=920ms, median=110ms. All failures routed via proxy-21.

Evan: decision: pin to v6.0.9 (no DB changes). Tori, flip routing and collect gcore + tcpdump from proxy-21.

Tori: applying pin now. ETA ~75s.

Deploy-bot: Routing updated — v6.1.0 weight set to 0%. v6.0.9 receives 100% traffic. Canary artifact retained for investigation.

Tori: started collections on proxy-21: sudo gcore -o /var/dumps/authproxy $(pgrep auth-proxy) and sudo tcpdump -c 1000 -w /tmp/proxy-21.pcap -i eth0 'port 443'. Uploading to s3://redwood-debug/3752468012/proxy-21/.

Trace-bot: filed RED-1587 linking synth job 3752468012-t1 and uploaded artifacts. Assigned to runtime/perf.

Evan: smokebot, run a short validation (30 reqs) against the standard pool to confirm no residual 502s.

Smokebot: validation job complete — 0/30 failed, p95=130ms.

Evan: leaving pin in place while runtime/perf investigates. Will update #status and the RED-1587 ticket with findings. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
